question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched dominance within the Chinese Communist Party, including removal of presidential term limits and placement of loyalists across the Politburo and military, underpins trader consensus that he will remain in office through the end of 2026. Preparations for a fourth term at the 2027 Party Congress further reinforce this positioning, with no public signals of an heir apparent or internal power shifts materializing in recent months. Speculation around delegation of authority or health concerns has surfaced periodically but lacks confirmation from official channels. Low-probability scenarios that could still alter the outcome include a sudden medical event forcing an abrupt transition or an unforeseen elite-level crisis disrupting the current leadership structure ahead of the congress.
